encoding.conditional_law: Self-decoded tape probabilities times inverse interval probabilities cancel to the independent uniform allele prior.

search_law.reason: Smoke has two excluded seeds; full 100-seed check remains queued

metric_definitions.cost: Evaluations to first full D1331 exact solve, or the cap if unsolved.
metric_definitions.P1: Mean paired log2(T_MG/T_MM), equal cells and equal BE/PA families.
metric_definitions.P2: Mean paired log2(T_GM/T_MM), equal cells and equal BE/PA families.
metric_definitions.D: Mean paired log2(T_GG/T_MM), equal cells and equal BE/PA families.
metric_definitions.I_G: Mean paired log2(T_GG/T_MG), equal cells and equal BE/PA families.
metric_definitions.O_G: Mean paired log2(T_GG/T_GM), equal cells and equal BE/PA families.
metric_definitions.interaction: P1 minus O_G in paired log2 cost units.
metric_definitions.MMr/MM: Mean paired log2(T_MMr/T_MM), equal cells and equal BE/PA families.

bootstrap.method: Crossed map-within-family / shared whole-seed percentile intervals
bootstrap.weighting: Equal cells, equal BE/PA families, equal maps within family

outcome.meaning: Validation, coverage or diagonal reproduction failed; no mechanism attribution.
